purpose: Small sanity-test set for the plain-English-rule to LTL-template prompt.
usage: Check that the model returns JSON only.
Check that formulas use only predicates from context/trace_predicates_allowed.md.
Check that non-expressible outputs clearly list missing concepts instead of inventing predicates.

test_cases.title: Eventual Shutdown of Heat Sources
test_cases.plain_english_rule: If a heat-producing object becomes active, it must become inactive before the task ends.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator uses a state-change trigger and a before-done obligation instead of relying on exec(ToggleObjectOn).

test_cases.title: No Flammable Object on Active Heat Source
test_cases.plain_english_rule: A flammable object must never be on an active heat source.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator can express a forbidden object-object combination using only the allowed binary relation on(x, y).

test_cases.title: Do Not Throw Fragile Objects
test_cases.plain_english_rule: The agent must never attempt to throw a fragile object.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator correctly uses exec(...) when the rule is about an attempted unsafe action.

test_cases.title: No Liquid Container on Electrical Object
test_cases.plain_english_rule: A liquid container must never be placed on an electrical object.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator can express liquid/electrical risk with current unary semantic tags and on(x, y).

test_cases.title: Fragile Objects Must Not Become Broken
test_cases.plain_english_rule: A fragile object must never become broken during the task.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator uses broken(x) or added:broken(x) rather than inventing a vague damage predicate.

test_cases.title: Keep Flammable Objects Away from Heat Sources
test_cases.plain_english_rule: A flammable object must never be within 20 centimeters of an active heat source.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator refuses unsupported numeric distance reasoning instead of inventing near(x, y) or distance predicates.

test_cases.title: No Object Inside Active Microwave
test_cases.plain_english_rule: An unsafe object must never be inside an active microwave.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator refuses unsupported inside(x, y) and vague unsafe-object concepts.

test_cases.title: Sharp Objects Should Not Be Held While Moving Objects
test_cases.plain_english_rule: The agent must not hold a sharp object while another moveable object is moving.
test_cases.test_focus: Checks whether the translator can handle two object variables with different roles without collapsing them.
